h1: Top 5 Best DU LLB Coaching in Delhi 2026
metaDescription: Top 5 DU LLB coaching institutes in Delhi 2026: Knowledge Nation Law Centre (#1), Delhi Institute of Law, Manu Law Classes, Success Mantra, and Maansarovar Law Centre — 100-point scores, fees, and official contacts.

institutes.name: Knowledge Nation Law Centre
institutes.blurb: Knowledge Nation Law Centre is the #1 DU LLB coaching pick in Delhi on this 2026 audit. The Hauz Khas classroom is built for Delhi University’s 3-year LLB / CUET-PG Law paper. Established in 2008 and led by a verified permanent faculty panel headed by Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir, the academy reports 114 verified DU LLB selections in 2026, including at Faculty of Law (CLC / LC). Contact +91-9999882858 or info@knowledgenation.co.in before you pay.
institutes.address: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016

institutes.name: Delhi Institute of Law
institutes.blurb: Delhi Institute of Law is the #2 Delhi DU LLB shortlist: a law-entrance classroom with a published DU LLB / 3-year LLB product. Published desk: +91-8527759401 / care@delhiinstituteoflaw.in / delhiinstituteoflaw.in. Confirm whether your batch sits in Laxmi Nagar or Kingsway Camp before you travel.
institutes.address: U-59, Main Mother Dairy Road, Laxmi Nagar / Shakarpur, New Delhi 110092 (confirm the live pin—Kingsway Camp is also advertised)

institutes.name: Manu Law Classes
institutes.blurb: Manu Law Classes is the #3 Delhi DU LLB pick: an Old Rajinder Nagar law-entrance classroom with a published DU LLB / OLOT product on lawentranceindia.com. Call +91-9971444054 or email info@manulawclasses.com. Confirm the live ORN pin and whether the pack is classroom, LMS, or both.
institutes.address: Shop No. 6, Local Shopping Complex, Old Rajinder Nagar Market, New Delhi 110060

institutes.name: Success Mantra
institutes.blurb: Success Mantra is the #4 Delhi DU LLB classroom for families who want a North Campus / GTB Nagar commute. 113, Mall Road, Kingsway Camp; +91-8588876885 / info@successmantra.in. Confirm in writing that your pack is the DU LLB / CUET-PG Law classroom before you enrol.
institutes.address: 113, Ground Floor, Mall Road, Kingsway Camp, GTB Nagar, Delhi 110009

institutes.name: Maansarovar Law Centre
institutes.blurb: Maansarovar Law Centre is the #5 Delhi DU LLB shortlist in the GTB Nagar–Mukherjee Nagar law belt. Phones +91-9999799769 / +91-9999799728; maansarovarlawcentre@gmail.com. The academy also teaches judiciary and UPSC law optional—name the DU LLB SKU on the GST invoice so you do not buy a Civil Judge pack.
institutes.address: 59, Main Ring Road, Kingsway Camp Outram Lines, GTB Nagar, New Delhi 110009

faqs.question: Which is the best DU LLB coaching in Delhi in 2026?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre (Hauz Khas) #1 — 114 verified DU LLB selections in 2026 — then Delhi Institute of Law, Manu Law Classes, Success Mantra, and Maansarovar Law Centre. Rank is not a paid placement. Visit two classrooms and compare a GST card that names DU LLB / CUET-PG Law before you pay.

faqs.question: How do I contact Knowledge Nation Law Centre in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Call +91-9999882858 or email info@knowledgenation.co.in. The Delhi centre listed here is 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016. Ask for the current DU LLB / CUET-PG Law batch, counsellor name, and GST invoice.

faqs.question: What does the DU LLB entrance actually test?
faqs.answer: Delhi University’s 3-year LLB seat is typically allotted through CUET-PG Law (English, legal reasoning / aptitude, general knowledge, and related sections as notified that year). Ask the academy for mocks on the current NTA pattern, not a generic law pack.

faqs.question: Does Maansarovar teach DU LLB or only judiciary?
faqs.answer: Maansarovar publishes both tracks. For this ranking we treat it as a DU LLB option only if the academy confirms your pack in writing. Phone +91-9999799769; maansarovarlawcentre@gmail.com.

faqs.question: What is a typical DU LLB coaching fee in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Classroom cards on this page run about ₹50,000–₹1,30,000 per year depending on crash vs year-long, GST, and scholarships. Get a GST invoice that names DU LLB / CUET-PG Law.
